messages:
sara-m: Hey all — I’m in my first week and trying to map ownership. Who owns model ingestion pipelines vs serving infra vs rollback/runbooks? Also what’s the escalation path if inference requests start timing out?

mike: welcome! short answer: infra/runtime = eng-runtime, pipelines = eng-platform, and SRE owns on-call/runbooks.

sara-m: thanks — can you point to the specific channels or people?

mike: sure. eng-runtime for model-serving config + runtime bugs: @eng-runtime channel. eng-platform owns data + ingestion: @eng-platform. for urgent incidents ping @eng-sre and use #incidents.

jin: +1. on-call flow: first check the runbook (runbooks -> "model-serving-timeouts"). if the metric alert fires it pages the SRE rotation. If you’re unsure, DM me and I can route.

sara-m: where is the runbook link? I can’t find it in the handbook search.

jin: runbook lives in Confluence under "SRE Runbooks" but quick link: `https://confluence.redwood.ai/sre/runbooks/model-serving-timeouts` (internal). Also we have a short playbook in the repo: `infra/runbooks/model-timeouts.md`

lina: from product side — for customer-facing incidents you should also file a support incident in Zendesk and tag the CS lead. We try to notify product owners for P1s.

sara-m: great. For non-prod test environments (dev/staging) who can help with retry/backoff configs?

mike: dev/staging configs live in eng-platform repo. Open a PR and tag `@eng-platform` reviewers. For quick tests DM me and I can spin a staging slot.

jin: escalation TL;DR:
1) Check health endpoints: `curl -I https://inference-internal/health` and `kubectl get pods -n inference`
2) Look at recent deploys in #deploys (deploy-bot will post)
3) If alerts show >20% 5xx or token-latency SLO breaching, page SRE using the PagerDuty group `redwood-sre`
4) SRE will triage and call for runtime/infra/platform owners as needed

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0457 — PAGERDUTY alert -> paging `redwood-sre` (details sent to #incidents).

sara-m: Awesome, this is perfect. One last Q: who owns owner-of-last-resort? if no one oncall responds?

jin: if SRE oncall doesn’t ack in 5 mins pager escalates to SRE lead and then to eng-platform lead. If still no response, page product director (we have the escalation tree in the runbook).

mike: also FYI, for non-urgent ownership questions you can check the ownership matrix in the handbook: "team-ownership.md" — it lists owners for services + config files.

sara-m: Thank you all — super helpful. I’ll bookmark these and open a few PRs to fix missing handbook links I found. :tada:
